stem: A student completes a 14-hour shift and asks that every hour count toward internship credit. Select all supported statements.

choices.text: No more than 12 hours may be credited for that day.
All 14 hours must be credited because the student was present.
The remaining work time does not override the daily internship-credit cap.
The cap is eight hours per week.
Only hours involving controlled substances count.

explanation.core_reasoning: Apply each proposition independently. A pharmacy intern may receive no more than 12 hours of pharmacy internship credit in one day.

choice_analysis.C: The proposition 'The remaining work time does not override the daily internship-credit cap.' is supported by Daily pharmacy internship credit limit: A pharmacy intern may receive no more than 12 hours of pharmacy internship credit in one day.
choice_analysis.D: This statement imports Massachusetts Schedule VI prescription-drug status without its required trigger and is not supported by the scenario.
choice_analysis.E: This statement imports Schedule II partial fill caused by pharmacy inability without its required trigger and is not supported by the scenario.

related_facts: A pharmacy intern may receive no more than 12 hours of pharmacy internship credit in one day.
